At the DW relic mixing, the line energies are E = 3.55, 10, 14.5, 20.5 and 23 keV for m_s = 7.1, 20, 29, 41 and 46 keV. The whole-halo M31 fluxes are 1.75e-3, 1.71e-2, 3.88e-2, 8.31e-2 and 0.107 ph/s/cm^2. The tool's tabulated limits exclude m_s = 7.1 keV (NuSTAR M31 Roach+2020 and XMM blank sky Dessert+2020) and m_s = 20 keV (NuSTAR M31). They report no tabulated limit within 30% in mass at 29, 41 or 46 keV. That means no coverage, not that these masses are allowed.

On the sterile-nu server (DW mechanism), Omega_s h^2 scales linearly with sin^2 2theta and roughly as m_s^1.8. The mixed cold-plus-warm Lyman-alpha bound of Boyarsky+2009 (arXiv:0812.0010), with masses expressed as non-resonantly produced sterile-neutrino masses, allows any mass in 5 keV < m_NRP < infinity when F_WDM < 0.6 (frequentist 99.7% CL) or F_WDM < 0.35 (Bayesian 95%). The pure-WDM bounds are m_NRP > 8 keV (99.7%) and 12.1 keV (Bayesian 95%).

NuSTAR Galactic Center observations (Perez+2017, arXiv:1609.00667) give, by the abstract's own description, the strongest X-ray line limits on sterile-neutrino mixing over most of 10-50 keV in mass, improving earlier limits by up to about 10x. This is the published limit set that covers the DW-equivalent masses of 29-46 keV, which the server's tabulated limits do not cover.

I made a DW exclusion plot over m_s = 1-100 keV and sin^2 2theta = 1e-14 to 1e-6, from an 80x80 scan (6400 points): 3092 points overclose and 968 are BBN-excluded. The plot shows the overclosure region, the Omega_DM line, the NuSTAR/XMM limits, the Lyman-alpha thermal-WDM bound and the 3.5 keV point. It is Figure 10.

Inverting Viel+2005 by hand, these correspond to thermal-relic masses of about 1.56 and 2.12 keV, which are older and weaker than the 3.1-5.7 keV limits. Perez+2017 (arXiv:1609.00667, NuSTAR Galactic Center 0-bounce photons) states in the text that, within the nuMSM, its limit gives an upper bound on the sterile-neutrino mass of m_chi below about 16 keV. The nuMSM allowed band in its Fig. 8 lies between the non-resonant (DW) production line above and the maximum-lepton-asymmetry resonant line below. Perez+2017 Eq. 5 gives the GC decay-line flux as F ≈ 2.6e-6 cm^-2 s^-1 (m/20 keV)^4 (sin^2 2theta/1e-14)(dOmega/4 deg^2)(J/40 GeV cm^-3 kpc sr^-1), with dOmega_tot ≈ 3.8 deg^2 and J_tot = 29 GeV cm^-3 kpc sr^-1 for the default coreNFW profile. Applied to the DW relic mixing at 20 keV (3.9e-11), this predicts about 7e-3 ph/cm^2/s in the NuSTAR 0-bounce aperture (my hand calculation). Numerical flux and sin^2 2theta limits are shown only in Figs. 6-8, which are not machine-readable here.
